subject: pathology
title: Insulinoma, Gastrinoma, Glucagonoma, and MEN Syndromes with RET

steps.tx: Insulinoma, usually benign pancreatic beta cell tumour, secretes insulin unsuppressed by hypoglycaemia producing Whipple triad fasting neuroglycopenia relieved by glucose. That triad tumour is **insulinoma with Whipple triad**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Symptoms, low glucose documented, relief on correction: Whipple triad earns insulinoma hunting.

vis.caption: Insulinoma with Whipple triad of fasting hypoglycaemia.

steps.tx: Supervised fasting with insulin, C-peptide, proinsulin, and sulfonylurea screening separates insulinoma from factitious insulin or secretagogue abuse biochemically. That fast protocol is **72-hour fast in endogenous hyperinsulinism**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Unsuppressed insulin plus C-peptide at low glucose means endogenous; absent C-peptide means injected insulin.

steps.tx: Gastrinoma secretes gastrin driving acid hypersecretion, refractory and multiple peptic ulcers, diarrhoea, and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome, duodenum now commoner source than pancreas. That acid flood is **gastrinoma and Zollinger-Ellison syndrome**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made. That is why this detail earns its place in every examination and ward round.
steps.say: Refractory ulcers beyond duodenal bulb plus diarrhoea mean gastrin; hunt duodenal gastrinoma.

vis.caption: Gastrinoma locations in gastrinoma triangle and metastatic spread.

steps.tx: Secretin stimulation paradoxically raises gastrin in gastrinoma, while proton pump inhibitors falsify fasting gastrin and must be stopped carefully before testing. That provocation is the **secretin stimulation test for gastrinoma**. Remembering it prevents the commonest errors made with this presentation entirely. The clinical payoff comes from applying it early, before complications accumulate further.
steps.say: Secretin should suppress gastrin; paradoxical rise convicts gastrinoma after PPI washout discipline.

steps.tx: Glucagonoma rash necrolytic migratory erythema migrates with diabetes, glossitis, weight loss, and thrombosis from alpha cell tumours usually metastatic at discovery. That migrating rash is **necrolytic migratory erythema of glucagonoma**. This point is tested repeatedly because it changes everyday bedside decisions. Examiners return to it because it separates careful clinicians from guesswork.
steps.say: Migrating necrolytic rash plus new diabetes means glucagonoma until plasma glucagon acquits it.

nodes.label: Hypoglycaemia or ulcer syndrome proven hormonal

steps.tx: MEN 1, Wermer syndrome, assembles parathyroid hyperplasia, pituitary adenomas, and enteropancreatic tumours from menin loss, hypercalcaemia usually first in young families. That three P family is **multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 (MEN 1)**. Bedside recognition of this pattern saves time, blood, and unnecessary investigation.
steps.say: Parathyroid, pituitary, pancreas: MEN 1 counts three Ps and starts with young hypercalcaemia.

steps.tx: MEN 2A adds medullary thyroid cancer and phaeochromocytoma to parathyroid disease, MEN 2B earlier aggressive medullary cancer with mucosal neuromas and marfanoid habitus without parathyroid. Those RET families are **MEN 2A and MEN 2B syndromes**. Students should anchor this fact before moving to rarer causes and exceptions.
steps.say: Mucosal neuromas plus marfanoid build mean MEN 2B; thyroidectomy clocks run fastest there.

steps.tx: RET proto-oncogene activating mutations stratify medullary cancer risk by codon scheduling prophylactic thyroidectomy childhood ages and phaeochromocytoma screening before any surgery. That codon clock is **RET codon based prophylactic thyroidectomy in MEN 2**. In practice this distinction decides the next test, treatment, or referral made.
steps.say: The RET codon sets the childhood thyroidectomy date; phaeochromocytoma screening precedes every operation.
